snippet.title: Haneda Girl Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Take another look to Haneda Girl. Swap between characters and clean up the menace in the faster, smarter and most efficient way. Haneda Girl will be available on PC Steam on May 23, 2025

Play the DEMO.Out now on STEAM
https://store.steampowered.com/app/32...


"Move like in CELESTE

Destroy like in BRO FORCE

Slash like in KATANA ZERO

And die like in HOTLINE MIAMI"

Are you in?
